name: Clave
description: Clave is a self-custodial smart wallet powered by ZKsync, aimed at providing a seamless and user-friendly payment experience with zero gas fees. It offers one-click onboarding, gasless transactions, and access to yield opportunities within the ZK ecosystem. Clave emphasizes security through hardware-level protection and social recovery, allowing users to manage their wallets without needing to remember complex seed phrases. The application is designed with a mobile-first approach, utilizing biometric authentication and passkeys to ensure that users'private keys remain secure on their devices.
